name: Golden Marriage -Jewel Days-
source:
This is the fandisc for Golden Marriage, featuring after stories for all six heroines (Marika included). There’s also two extra episodes, including one with alcohol. There’s plenty of new situations, in wedding dresses, swimsuits or yukata. Marriage isn’t your life’s goal; it’s a new beginning! Enjoy your sweet honeymoon!

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/03/09/march-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是《黄金婚姻》的同人光盘，收录了所有六位女主角（包括玛丽卡）的后续故事。还有两集额外的情节，其中一集是关于酒精的。婚纱、泳衣或浴衣都有很多新的场景。婚姻不是你人生的目标；而是你的人生目标。这是一个新的开始！享受甜蜜的蜜月！

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/03/09/march-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
